summary: Vir Biotechnology filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of common stock, with the public offering price, share count, and gross proceeds left blank in this preliminary filing. Shares trade on Nasdaq under VIR; the last reported sale on November 11, 2026 was $13.13. Leerink Partners, Morgan Stanley, Evercore ISI, and Raymond James are joint bookrunners, and the underwriters hold a 30-day option to purchase additional shares. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing, discount to last sale, and dilution from the greenshoe.
